final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS c1, AVG(HGB) AS c2, AVG(CAST("T-BIL" AS REAL) / CRE) AS c3 FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS c1 FROM s1) SELECT s1.c1, s1.c2, s1.c3, s1.c3 / s2.c1 AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.c1 IS NOT NULL
